_comment: JSON-door fidelity ledger for the chain .hdc -> hero -> json -> hero -> .hdc. Shrink-only, with a staleness ratchet in test_build_doc_ledger_is_not_stale. Same rules as export_known_gaps.json.
_gaps_comment: Defects: attributes or elements a character LOSES through the JSON door. Empty, and meant to stay that way. Measured at 0/794 clean before this door existed (609 element kinds dropped, 5,014 attribute keys churned); the curated build doc it replaced had no attribute-level gate at all.
_matches_hd_comment: The SAME two entries the .hdc door carries, for the same reasons, and they arrive here through it: the JSON door re-materialises the element tree the .hdc writer produces, so anything HD itself normalises on a re-save normalises identically in both. See export_known_gaps.json for the Java behind each.
